sanskrit: Śivaḥ karotu nijayā namaḥ śaktyā tatātmane || 1 ||
Nature (tat-ātmane) when (He) hinders or conceals His own Self --i.e. let Śiva do not conceal His own Self-- (ātmā-nivāraṇe) . || 1 ||
Tadicchā tāvatī tāvajjñānaṃ tāvatkriyā hi sā || 3 ||
moment of beholding terror --i.e. something terrifying-- (dara-saṃ-darśana-kṣaṇe) . || 9 ||
eagerness or fondness for that --i.e. creation-- (tat-aunmukhyam) . || 10
Tasyecchā kāryatāṃ yātā yayā secchaḥ sa jāyate || 16 ||

Some (kaiścid) sages (mahadbhiḥ) say (ucyate) it is (sā) only (eva) a bulge (ucchūnatā) . That (sā) is His (tasya) Will (icchā) achieving (yātā) some (kiṃcid) effect --i.e. creates something-- (kāryatām) , by which (yayā) (only) that (saḥ) desire (icchaḥ) is manifested (jāyate) . || 16 ||
participate in grossness --i.e. He will never become gross just because His eagerness is expanded (sthūlatvabhāk) . || 17 ||
Tasyāḥ pūrvāparau bhāgau kalpanīyau purā hi yā || 19 ||
Na nivṛttā na caunmukhyaṃ nivṛttaṃ nāpi nirvṛtiḥ || 22 ||
of one of the two --i.e. aspects of Will-- (ekataraniryāṇe) ; hence (tasmāt) , Oneness (sāmarasyam) continues to exist (avasthitam) in all the objects (sarva-padārthānām) . || 23 ||

the perception of a pot (ghaṭa-ādi-graha-kāle) , it (sā) is ‘kriyā’ or an activity (kriyā) (which) cognizes (jānāti) the pot (ghaṭam) and (eva) cognizes (jānāti) cognition (jñānam) there (atra) . For someone without Will (niricchoḥ) , there is no perception (of anything) (vedana-kṣatiḥ) . || 24 ||
Dveṣye pravartate naiva na ca vetti vinā citam || 25 ||
thing --i.e. saṃsāra-- (dveṣye) , and (ca) would not (na) cognize (anything) (vetti) without (vinā) Consciousness (citam) . || 25 ||
Na ca tasya tayā yoga iti cedaparasthitau || 26 ||
Jñānaṃ bodhamayaṃ tasya śivasya sahajaṃ sadā || 27 ||

the forms (rūpāṇi) in that way (tāvatā) , then (yāvat) the gross (sthūlam) manifestation of lifeless (matter) (jaḍa-ābhāsam) like earth (pārthivam) forming one mass (saṃhatam) is complete (ghanam) . || 27 - 33 ||
Ādadat tena tena eva rūpeṇa pravibhāvyate || 35 ||

with the places and feelings of the appearance of (such) bodies (bhāvanāḥ…sthāna-anurūptaḥ…dehākāreṇa) , (He) takes (ādadat) (these) and appears in many --lit. whatever-- (tena…tena…eva) (different) shapes (rūpeṇa…pravibhāvyate) . || 35 ||
Tathā prabhuḥ pramodātmā krīḍatyevaṃ tathā tathā || 38 ||

pralayakevalin --i.e. the knower of dissolution-- (pralayakevalī) . Sometimes (kvacid) (, He) is aware of (His) Self (ātmā-bodhī) , (but still) devoid of power (vikalavat) , (so He) is a vijñānakevalin (vijñānakevalī) . || 39-43 ||
Na cāsti sādhanaṃ kiṃcinmṛdādīcchāṃ vinā prabhoḥ || 44 ||
Evaṃ sarveṣu bhāveṣu yathā sā śivarūpatā || 46 ||
